relations.rationale: Pia taller than Kai does not by itself establish Pia vs Leo without the Kai-Leo link, so it's only weakly related; treated as unrelated given only these two claims.
Height comparison has no bearing on when the group starts descending.
Pia's height relative to Kai has no bearing on Hana's club role.
Stopping to discuss terrain sets up the context in which Esme could describe the upcoming climb, making it more plausible.
Stopping at midday for lunch does not determine whether the afternoon sun grew warm.
A midday lunch stop has no direct bearing on the valley view later at the summit.
Esme's statement about a steep climb is the direct antecedent to everyone nodding in agreement.
A statement about terrain difficulty has no bearing on relative heights of Kai and Leo.
Knowing a steep climb is coming makes frequent rest breaks more plausible/likely.
Kai taller than Leo alone doesn't establish Pia's height relative to Leo without connecting to Pia, so it's not directly supportive on its own.
Hana pointing out the bird nest directly leads to the group pausing to admire it.
Noticing a bird nest could plausibly prompt photography, but it's not specifically tied to Leo taking photos.
Pointing out a bird nest is a minor detail unrelated to overall satisfaction with the hike.
Warm afternoon sun makes it more plausible the group would take breaks to rest and refill water.
The afternoon sun growing warm doesn't directly indicate when the sky darkens or descent begins.
Taking breaks to refill bottles is consistent with sharing tea from a thermos, though not strictly causal.
Frequent breaks for rest don't specifically indicate when the descent begins.
Reaching the summit in late afternoon directly enables the valley view described.
Reaching the summit sets up the subsequent descent as the sky darkens.
Reaching the summit is a precursor to later moving along the rocky path back, supporting that sequence.
